newsitem.title: MEXICO: GFBanorte Q1 1997 net 60.9 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: GFBanorte Q1 1997 net 60.9 mln pesos.

text.p: Grupo Financiero Banorte announced on Tuesday a net profit of 60.9 million pesos in Q1 1997, and a capitalization ratio on March 31 of 13.4 percent.

For the first time, the banking group reported earnings under new U.S. accounting standards, as did all other Mexican banks. It said its results compared with a profit of 90.6 million pesos in Q1 1996, before the new accounting rules were introduced.
It said deposits grew to 30.537 billion pesos in the quarter, up some 14.7 percent in real terms.
Banorte had a reserve coverage of past-due loans of 60.9 percent at the end of the quarter, well above the 45 percent required by law.
Reserve coverage was 109 percent of credit card debts, 62 percent of commercial loans and 51 percent of mortgages, Banorte director Othon Ruiz Montemayor told a news conference.
